detail.longDescription: Hi HN, I'm Matteo from meshapplied (YC W27), building this with Peter and Janos. We think you can and should own your inference, so we built software that actually supports that. Goethe turns a Linux machine with an NVIDIA GPU into an API your OpenAI, Anthropic compatible clients can call. ``` curl -fsSL https://goethe.sh/install.sh | bash goethe start ``` Limits: it's Linux only rn and it supports Ampere or newer NVIDIA GPUs. Logging in with `goethe login` is optional and turns on the optimized kernels. Docs: [goethe.sh/docs]( https://goethe.sh/docs ) I'd love to hear what breaks and what you'd want next.
